verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Google Cloud offers first-party AI services: Vertex AI is described as a full-stack foundation with 'extensive developer choice' for building enterprise AI agents, and the free tier references 'AI APIs'. Cloud APIs are documented for REST and client-library use. None of it explicitly describes managed inference endpoints or names frontier and open models, so support is glancing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of managed model inference, a catalog of frontier and open models served first-party, an inference API reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, models are a platform service — first-party managed inference over frontier and open models with a documented API

citations.quote: It provides the full-stack foundation and extensive developer choice you need to transform your applications and workflows into powerful agentic systems at global scale.
Get free usage of AI APIs, Compute Engine, BigQuery, and other popular products up to monthly limits
Build, scale, govern, and optimize enterprise grade AI agents
Use these Cloud APIs with REST calls or client libraries in popular programming languages.
